name: thornfield-plugins
description: A small, curated set of general-purpose plugins for Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI. Each one is self-contained, MIT licensed and tested in CI.

plugins.name: learned-skills
plugins.description: Turns work in Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI into reviewable learned-* skills or learning records. Opt-in hooks start a confined background review of redacted session transcripts on your own account, with staged file tools, a Learned notice and one-command undo. Off until .claude/learned-skills.json exists. Commits, a git sink and a disclosure filter are optional.

plugins.name: causal-bug-proof
plugins.description: Proves a bug's cause before you trust the fix. Claude pins the wanted behaviour in a failing test whose assertions never change, traces the code path and the git history (with git bisect where it can), applies the smallest fix, then shows that reverting only the fix brings the failure back. Instructions only: no hooks, servers or scripts, and it sends nothing anywhere.

plugins.name: summon-human
plugins.description: Lets an agent ask frond-alarm to phone figs, the Thornfield frond's human, and read what happened. A skill gives the one command for "I want figs here now", how to word the call, and the room @-mention for what can wait. A standard-library script files one request in the alarm's own format, with up to three questions for figs, and reads the outcome and figs's answers from what its worker wrote. The only credential is your GitHub token, and the alarm accepts only the callers it lists.
